name: i love you two, too
source:
After losing her apartment, Ivy is moving in with her girlfriends, Mace & Poppy.  Will she be able to get through her anxieties and trust her lovers with her fears?

[From [url=https://norbez.itch.io/i-love-you-two-too]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
失去公寓后，艾薇搬去和她的女朋友梅斯和波比住在一起。她能否克服焦虑，并相信她的爱人能够承受她的恐惧？
